notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.text: The link may be wrong, or the page may have moved.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to this page
forbidden.text: Your staff role does not include this section. Ask a platform admin if you need it for your work.
forbidden.needs: This page needs one of these staff roles: {{roles}}.
forbidden.request: To get access, ask a platform admin to grant the role. Access requests from the console come later.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: The page could not be shown. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the platform team the reference below.

signin.title: Staff sign-in
signin.intro: Sign in with your staff email and password, then confirm with your security key.
signin.withKey: Sign in with a security key

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.text: Enter your work email. If it belongs to an account, we send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If the address belongs to an account, a link is on its way. Open it, set a new password, then sign in here again.

signin.stepUpText: This action needs a fresh confirmation with your security key. You will return to the page you were on.

errors.invalid: The email or password is not correct. If your staff account was disabled, ask a platform admin.
errors.network: The sign-in service cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.keyFailed: This security key was not accepted. Use the key registered for your staff account.
errors.notDeviceBound: This passkey syncs across devices. Staff sign-in accepts only a key bound to one device: a security key, or this computer's built-in key (for example Windows Hello).
errors.codeWrong: The code is not correct. Check the latest email and try again.
errors.codeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from the email.
errors.alreadyRegistered: This security key is already registered. Use another key, or start again and sign in with this one.
errors.unsupported: This browser cannot use security keys. Use a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
errors.initialExpired: Signing in for the first time? An initial password works for 7 days. If yours is older, ask the server operator for a new initial password.

mfa.title: Confirm with your security key
mfa.text: Insert or touch your security key, or use this computer's built-in key, when the browser asks.
mfa.added: Security key added. Now confirm with it once to finish signing in.

enrol.title: Set up your security key
enrol.why: Your staff account has no security key yet. Staff sign in with a key that stays on one device: a USB or NFC security key, or this computer's built-in key. Passkeys that sync to a phone or a cloud account are not accepted.
enrol.sent: We sent a 6-digit code to your work email. Enter it, then follow the browser's prompt to create the key.
enrol.codeHint: The code is valid for 10 minutes.
enrol.noCode: No email after a minute? Start again to get a new code.
enrol.sameCode: Use the same 6-digit code from the email (filled in for you), then follow the browser's prompt to create the key.

locked.title: Sign-in is paused
locked.text: Too many attempts. You can try again when the timer ends.

expired.title: This sign-in page has expired
expired.text: Sign-in pages are valid for 30 minutes. Start again; you will come back to the page you wanted.
expired.keySaved: Your new security key was saved. Start again and sign in with it.
expired.recovery: Your recovery request is kept. Start again from this browser to continue it.
expired.passwordSaved: Your new password is saved. Start again and sign in with it (the initial password no longer works).

gate.title: Use the company network
gate.text: The admin console can only be reached from the company network. Connect to it (or to the company VPN) and try again.

outcome.expired: The sign-in took too long or was opened in another tab. Sign in again.
outcome.state: The sign-in took too long or was opened in another tab. Sign in again.
outcome.issuer: Sign-in failed. Sign in again; if it keeps failing, tell the platform team.
outcome.failed: Sign-in failed. Sign in again; if it keeps failing, tell the platform team.
outcome.step_up: The sign-in did not use a security key bound to one device. Use your security key.
outcome.account: Confirm with the same staff account you are signed in with.
outcome.not_staff: This account has no staff role. Sign in with your staff account.

recover.title: Recover your staff account
recover.intro: Lost your security key? Enter your work email, your password and one of your recovery codes. Two other administrators then check with you and approve the recovery, and you add a new key.
recover.forgotten: I have forgotten my password too
recover.codeHint: One of the codes you stored when you added your key, e.g. ABCD-EFGH-JKMN-PQRS-TVWX.
recover.sent: If the details were right, we sent a 6-digit code to your work email. Enter it to send the request to the administrators.
recover.again: No email? Check the details and try again
recover.waitText: Two other administrators must approve your recovery. They will check with you outside CarPal first: a call to your known number, in person or a video call.
recover.comeBack: You can close this page. When you get the approval email, open the admin console in this browser and sign in again to continue.
recover.approved: Two administrators approved your recovery. Set up your new security key now.
recover.keyTitle: Set up your new security key
recover.keyText: Your old keys and recovery codes stop working. Use a key that stays on one device: a USB or NFC security key, or this computer’s built-in key.
recover.newPasswordHint: At least {{n}} characters. Not a password you used before.

ended.gone: There is no open recovery request in this browser. Sign in, or ask for a recovery again.
ended.rejected: Your recovery request was rejected. Ask an administrator what to do next.
ended.expired: Your recovery request expired before it was finished. Ask for a recovery again.
ended.completed: Your account was already recovered. Sign in with your new security key.

errors.notApproved: The request is not approved, or it has expired. Check its state and try again.
errors.notFound: There is no open recovery request in this browser.
errors.codeFormat: Enter one of your recovery codes, e.g. ABCD-EFGH-JKMN-PQRS-TVWX.
errors.details: The request could not be sent. Check the details and try again.
errors.passwordLength: The new password must have 12 to 128 characters.
errors.passwordRepeat: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.password: This password cannot be used. Choose a longer one that you have not used before.

initial.title: Choose your own password
initial.why: Your staff account was set up with an initial password. Choose your own password before you continue; this step cannot be skipped.
initial.sent: We sent a 6-digit code to your work email. Enter it with your new password.

rules.breached: not a password known from data breaches
rules.tip: A passphrase of several unrelated words is long and easy to remember.

strength.fair: Strength: fair. A longer password is stronger.

errors.length: The new password must be 12 to 128 characters long.
errors.repeat: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.breached: This password is known from data breaches. Choose another one.
errors.same: This is the initial password. Choose a password of your own.

signedOut.idleText: For security, staff sessions end after 30 minutes without activity. Sign in again to continue where you were.
signedOut.endedText: Staff sessions end after 8 hours, when your security key is changed, or when a platform admin ends them. Sign in again to continue.
signedOut.logoutText: You signed out of the admin console. Close the browser if you share this computer.

lookup.label: Look up
lookup.soon: Lookup arrives with the user and organization screens.

account.myActions: My actions in the audit log

section.text: This section is not built yet. It arrives in stage {{stage}} of the console plan.

idle.title: Still there?
idle.text: Without activity you will be signed out in {{time}}.
idle.endText: Your 8-hour session ends in {{time}}. Finish what you are doing; you will need to sign in again.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.text: This action needs a fresh confirmation with your security key. You will come back to this page and the action runs once.
stepUp.failed: The action could not be kept for after the confirmation. Try again.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.typing: Shortcuts are off while you type in a field.

reason.noteHint: Saved in the audit log with the reason. Up to {{n}} characters.
reason.noteRequired: Write a note: it is required for this action.
reason.noteTooLong: The note is too long (at most {{n}} characters).

confirm.understood: I understand, and I want to go ahead

fourEyes.title: Waiting for a second staff member
fourEyes.text: {{op}} was filed and has not taken effect. Another staff member must approve it.

problem.selfApproval: You requested this change yourself. A second staff member has to approve or reject it (four-eyes rule).
problem.invalidTransition: This is no longer possible: it expired or someone already decided it. The list has been refreshed.
problem.changed: Someone changed this record meanwhile. Reload it and try again.
problem.duplicate: The same change is already waiting for approval.
problem.purpose: Open this record from a work item first.
problem.purposeMismatch: This record is not part of the work item you opened it from. Open it from a work item about it.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not allow this action.
problem.notFound: This record does not exist any more.
problem.invalid: Some values were not accepted. Check them and try again.
problem.busy: Too many requests just now. Wait a moment and try again.
problem.network: No connection to the console. Check your network and try again.
problem.other: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps failing, report the request ID.
problem.recoveryRestricted: Your account was recovered recently: approvals, role changes and staff re-enabling are blocked until the restriction ends.

outcome.accepted: Accepted. It runs in the background.

purpose.title: Open this from a work item
purpose.text: Private data is shown only for an open work item (a case, dispute, privacy request, verification or review approval). Open the record from that item.

masked.noPurpose: Open from a work item to reveal
masked.logged: Revealing is recorded in the audit log.

table.failed: The list could not be loaded.
table.viewsLocal: Views keep only filters, in this browser.

ai.label: AI assessment
ai.humanDecides: An input for your decision. AI never decides.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.window: Entries from the last {{days}} days. Opening this view is itself recorded.

job.unreadable: The progress of the background job cannot be read. Reload the page later.
job.queued: The background job is waiting to start.
job.failed: The background job failed. Tell the engineering team.

codes.not_a_customer: Not a customer of this business
codes.invoice_needed: An invoice or receipt is needed
codes.photo_needed: A photo of the work is needed
codes.appointment_not_held: The appointment did not take place
codes.both_sides_needed: Both sides need to add information
codes.blur_needed: Plate or faces must be blurred
codes.legal_obligation: Legal obligation to keep the data
codes.not_requested_by_owner: Not asked for by the account owner

ops.review_move_to_approval_path: Review moved to the approval path

approvals.title: Pending approvals
approvals.intro: Changes that take effect only after a second staff member approves them. Check the change and its reason, then approve or reject with your own reason.
approvals.ownHint: Changes you requested yourself never appear here: someone else decides them.
approvals.notListed: This change is not in the list: it may be your own, already decided, expired, or not for your role.
approvals.pick: Choose a change from the list.
approvals.cannotDecide: Your role cannot decide this change.
approvals.approveEffect: Approving applies the change now, in your name as approver.
approvals.rejectEffect: Rejecting drops the change; the requester can file it again.
approvals.rejected: Rejected. The change will not be applied.
approvals.stepUpHint: Deciding needs a recent security-key sign-in; you may be asked to confirm with your key.

mine.title: Your requests
mine.none: You have not requested a change that needs a second staff member.
mine.error: Your requests could not be read. They are still listed for the approvers.
mine.expired: Nobody decided it before {{when}}, so it did not take effect.

work.title: My work
work.noQueues: Your roles have no work queues.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.intro: Prices are stored in US dollars. The rate says how many units of a display currency one US dollar is; the apps show prices in the display currency at this rate.
rates.displayOnly: Display only: stored prices, ranking and filters never use the rate.
rates.pick: Choose a currency to change its rate.
rates.newHint: Up to 4 decimal places. Persian digits are fine.

problem.format: Enter a number, with at most 10 digits before the point and 4 after.
problem.zero: The rate must be more than zero.
problem.sameKeep: This is the current rate. To confirm it for today, use the Keep button below.

rates.bigText: A second platform admin must approve this change before the apps use it.
rates.applied: Saved. The apps show the new rate within five minutes.
rates.refreshHint: The apps read rates from their configuration, which they refresh at least every five minutes.
rates.daily: The rate is set every morning. A rate not set today is marked, and administrators are reminded in the console and by email.
rates.todayMissing: The {{currency}} rate was last set {{ago}} by {{name}} ({{when}}). Enter today's rate, or keep this one for today.
rates.keepSummary: {{currency}} per US dollar stays at {{amount}} and is marked as set today.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.pick: Choose a flag to see its targeting.
flags.applied: Saved. Apps follow within one configuration refresh.
flags.aiNote: AI features also stop while the AI kill switch is on, whatever this flag says.

featured.title: Not part of the MVP
featured.text: Featured placements have no payment flow yet and nothing shows them. Turning this on needs a second platform admin.

kill.title: AI automation kill switch
kill.onText: Every AI feature is stopped: AI answers, suggestions and tools are unavailable in every app. Search, profiles and appointments keep working without AI.
kill.offText: AI features run as their own flags say. Turning the kill switch on stops every AI feature within one configuration refresh (about 30 seconds on the server).
kill.offNeedsSecond: Turning AI back on needs a second platform admin.
kill.dialogOnEffect: This takes effect at once for everybody. Turning it off again needs a second platform admin.
kill.failed: The kill switch could not be read. Reload the page.
kill.missing: The kill switch flag does not exist in this environment. Report it to the platform team.

dialog.fourEyes: A second platform admin must approve this change before it takes effect.

target.title: Targeting
target.intro: Who the flag is on for. Every criterion you set must match; nothing set means everyone.
target.regionsHint: Two-letter country codes separated by commas, for example IR. Empty: every region.
target.orgsHint: One ID per line, at most 500. Empty: every organization.
target.percentageHint: 0 to 100, the same users every time. Empty: all who match.

problem.regions_format: Use two-letter country codes such as IR, separated by commas.
problem.orgs_format: Each line must be one organization ID.
problem.percentage_format: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100, or leave it empty.

plans.title: Plans & entitlements

rule.title: Plans never change organic ranking
rule.text: A plan or a payment never moves anyone up or down in search, the map or Help Me. Plans change limits and tools only.

plans.historyHint: Every plan change is in the audit trail.
plans.pick: Choose a plan to see its entitlements.

ent.featured_placement_eligible: Featured placement eligible (no effect in the MVP)

plans.entIntro: Changes apply to every subscriber of this plan.
plans.countInvalid: Enter a whole number, or choose unlimited.

status.label: Plan status
status.hint: An inactive plan is no longer offered. The list does not show the current status.

plans.fourEyesHint: A plan change affects every subscriber, so a second platform admin must approve it.

assign.title: Assign a plan
assign.intro: Assign a plan, start a trial or set limits for one user or organization. It applies at once and replaces the current subscription.
assign.searchFailed: The search did not work. Try again.
assign.orgIdHint: Filled in when you choose an organization above, or paste one.
assign.userIdHint: Copy it from the work item. Finding a person needs a work item.
assign.planHint: Only the plans this subscriber may take are listed.
assign.trialEndHint: The last day of the trial (required).
assign.overridesHint: For this subscriber only; the plan stays as it is.
assign.replaces: The current subscription ends now and is replaced.
assign.applied: Assigned. The subscriber's limits change at once.
assign.subscriberNotFound: No user or organization with this ID can take a plan.
assign.planNotForSubscriber: This plan is not for this kind of subscriber.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.intro: How long records are kept, and what happens to them afterwards.
retention.gaps: Adding a policy and the dry run (how many records the next run would affect) are not available yet.
retention.pick: Choose a policy to change it.
retention.daysInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 36,500.
retention.appliesToHint: Only records in this status, for example deleted. Empty: any status.
retention.statusHint: An inactive policy is not applied.
retention.fourEyesHint: Retention changes need a second platform admin before they apply.

verified.approved_without_visit: Approved by the business and CarPal

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.intro: Reviews written without a visit (Path 2) wait for the business for 7 days, then for a CarPal community reviewer, who has 2 working days. Confirm, reject or ask for evidence; a rating alone is never a reason to reject.

empty.awaiting_reviewer: No review waits for a CarPal reviewer.
empty.awaiting_business: No review waits for a business answer.

reviews.pick: Choose a review from the list.
reviews.unavailable: This review is no longer waiting for approval, or it does not exist.

decided.confirm: Confirmed. The review is published as “Approved by the business and CarPal”.
decided.reject: Rejected. The review is not published; the author is told the reason category and can appeal.
decided.evidence: Evidence requested. The review keeps waiting for approval until the author adds it.

reviews.crvOnly: Only community reviewers decide reviews awaiting approval. You can read the queue.

objected.title: The business says the author was not its customer
objected.text: This does not remove the review. A different staff member decides it on the objection dispute; the author may add evidence there.

reviews.ratingRule: A low rating alone is never a reason to reject or remove a review.

block.not_pending: This review is not waiting for approval.
block.business_pending: The business has until its deadline to answer. Confirm when it has answered or the deadline has passed.
block.business_rejected: The business objected: confirming happens by deciding the objection dispute.

confirm.title: Confirm this review
confirm.effect: The review is published as “Approved by the business and CarPal”, at the lower weight of Path 2.

reject.title: Reject this review
reject.effect: The review is not published. The author is told the reason category and can appeal.

evidence.title: Ask the author for evidence
evidence.effect: The author is asked for an invoice or a photo; the review keeps waiting for approval.

cases.intro: Reported, AI-flagged and rule-flagged reviews. Take an action with a reason, then close the case. Moving a review to the approval path needs a second moderator.
cases.resolutionHint: What was decided, for the case record (at most {{n}} characters).
cases.pick: Choose a case from the list.
cases.unavailable: This case is closed, handled by someone else, or does not exist.
cases.handledBy: Being handled by {{name}}: only they can open it now.
cases.closedSummary: Closed cases show their summary only.
cases.targetGone: The review of this case is no longer available.
cases.cannotAct: Your role cannot act on moderation cases.
cases.cannotActNow: Actions need the case to be open and yours or unassigned.

done.remove: Removed. The review is hidden from everyone and kept for audit; scores are recalculated.

move.title: Move to the approval path
move.text: When the visit evidence of this review proves invalid, it becomes a Path 2 review: unpublished, waiting for the business and a CarPal reviewer. A second moderator must approve the move.

cases.empty: No review case matches these filters.

dialog.move: Move this review to the approval path

effect.approve: The review the automatic checks held back is published as a verified visit.
effect.remove: The review disappears from public pages and scores; it is kept for audit and can be restored.
effect.restore: The review comes back as it was before the removal.
effect.warn_user: The author gets a warning with the reason category.
effect.move: Files a four-eyes request. After a second moderator approves, the review is unpublished and waits for the business and a CarPal reviewer.
effect.close: The case leaves the open queue with this outcome and resolution.

disputes.title: Disputes & appeals
disputes.intro: Disagreements that need a human decision: business objections to reviews, review and badge disputes, service-record corrections, mediation requests and appeals. A different staff member from the one who made the decision under dispute decides.
disputes.unavailable: This dispute is decided, handled by someone else, or does not exist.
disputes.pick: Choose a dispute from the list.
disputes.handledBy: Being handled by {{name}}: only they can open it now.
disputes.targetNotShown: The console cannot show this record yet; use its ID to look it up.
disputes.decidedSummary: Decided disputes show their summary only.
disputes.noThread: Messages to each side are not available in the console yet.
disputes.reviewNotPath2: This review is not on the approval path, so its details are shown in its moderation case.

done.in_mediation: Mediation started. Both sides are invited to add information.
done.resolved_upheld: Upheld. The outcome is applied and both sides are told.
done.resolved_rejected: Rejected. The original decision stands and both sides are told.

disputes.cannotDecideNow: Deciding needs the dispute to be open and yours or unassigned.
disputes.differentStaff: Rule: you cannot decide a dispute you raised or about a decision you made. A colleague decides it.
disputes.resolutionHint: Both sides see it (at most {{n}} characters).
disputes.resolutionInvalid: Write the outcome message (at most {{n}} characters).
disputes.notesHint: Only staff see these (at most {{n}} characters).
disputes.withdrawNote: Only the person who raised a dispute can withdraw it.

refused.title: A colleague must decide this
refused.text: You raised this dispute or made the decision under dispute. A different staff member has to decide it.

effect.mediation: Both sides are invited to add information. Decide when they have.
effect.objectionUpheld: The review is published with the label “Disputed by the business”.
effect.objectionRejected: The business's objection stands: the review is rejected and not published.
effect.fakeUpheld: The review is removed as a confirmed fake and the trust rules for fakes apply.
effect.appealUpheld: The hidden or removed content is restored.
effect.manualUpheld: The outcome is recorded; correct the record itself where it is kept.
effect.keepTarget: Nothing changes on the record; the original decision stands.

outcomesObjection.resolved_upheld: Publish the review (the objection is not accepted)
outcomesObjection.resolved_rejected: Accept the objection (the review is rejected)

moderation.title: Content moderation

intro.reports: What users reported. Open a case (it gathers every open report about the same item), add the report to the open case, or dismiss it — always with a reason. Safety reports come first.
intro.content: Cases about posts, comments, questions, answers, showcase items, files and business replies. Safety cases come first. Take an action with a reason, then close the case with a resolution.
intro.accounts: Cases about user accounts, organizations and locations: warnings, suspensions (with the security key), trust penalties and badges.
intro.ai: Cases about AI output users reported or the checks flagged. Removing hides the output from its owner; it stays for audit.

inventory.title: Inventory moderation
inventory.intro: Cases about parts listings and fitment records: counterfeit suspicion, wrong fitment, prohibited items, duplicates and wrong vendor data. Send a listing back for correction, hide or remove it, reject a fitment record, or penalise the vendor.

moderation.viewNote: A view narrows the cases on this page; the list cannot filter by source or reason yet.
moderation.morePerType: Showing up to {{n}} cases of each type. Choose a type to page through all of them.
moderation.safetyFirst: Safety case: decide within 4 hours. Unsafe advice is removed or annotated, never left as it is.
moderation.targetGone: The {{thing}} of this case is no longer available.

media.internal: Internal copy for this case only; the link ends at {{when}}. Do not save or share it.

effect.approve: The {{thing}} passes moderation and becomes visible where its owner published it.
effect.hide: The {{thing}} is hidden from everyone but kept for review; it can be restored.
effect.remove: The {{thing}} is removed from public pages and kept for audit; it can be restored. Scores are recalculated.
effect.removeOnly: The {{thing}} is taken down for everyone (for this kind of item hiding and removing are the same); it is kept for audit and can be restored.
effect.restore: The {{thing}} comes back as it was before.
effect.request_changes: The {{thing}} goes back to its owner to fix; your note tells them what to change.
effect.warn_user: The person gets a warning with the reason category.
effect.suspend_account: The account cannot sign in or act until a moderator reactivates it (timed suspensions are not lifted automatically yet). Needs your security key.
effect.reactivate_account: The account can sign in and act again.
effect.apply_trust_penalty: Lowers the organization's trust score for 12 months. It cannot be undone from the console. Needs your security key.
effect.revoke_badge: The badge disappears from the organization's profile at once.

portfolio.approve: The showcase item is published on the provider's profile with its photos.
portfolio.remove: The showcase item is rejected and goes back to the provider; its photos are taken down.
portfolio.restore: The showcase item goes back to the review queue (not published yet).
portfolio.request_changes: The showcase item goes back to the provider as a draft (for example to blur a plate).

fitment.remove: The fitment record is rejected: the listing no longer shows this vehicle.
fitment.restore: The fitment record is active again.

ai.remove: The AI output is hidden from its owner and kept for audit.
ai.restore: The AI output is visible to its owner again.

inventory.request_changes: The listing goes back to the vendor as a draft; your note says what to correct.

done.apply_trust_penalty: The penalty is recorded; the trust score is recalculated.

blocked.consent_missing: Approve is not possible: the customer has not given a valid showcase consent. Request changes or reject.

assign.hint: Others then see that you handle it.

account.text: Suspensions are never bulk. Suspending asks for your security key again.

penalty.title: Trust penalty
penalty.text: For confirmed fake reviews, repeated violations or misleading listings of this organization:
penalty.pointsInvalid: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

moderation.stepUp: You will be asked for your security key before this is sent.
moderation.locationHint: To fix a wrong location, correct it on the organization's page (Organizations); this case records the report.

badge.title: Badges
badge.text: The Verified Business badge waits for staff approval; an active badge can be revoked from a case about the organization.
badge.approveEffect: The badge becomes active and shows on the organization's profile.
badge.revokeEffect: The badge disappears from the organization's profile at once. The organization is told.
badge.listError: The badges could not be read.
badge.nonePending: No badge is waiting for approval.
badge.more: Only the newest {{n}} badges are shown.

reports.pick: Choose a report from the list.
reports.gone: This report is not in the list any more.
reports.triaged: The report is in a case now.
reports.atLeastHigh: Unsafe advice, media without consent and private data are at least high.
reports.linkText: There is already an open case about the same item ({{reason}}):

dialog.open_case: Open a case for this report
dialog.link: Add this report to the open case

effect.open_case: A {{severity}} case is opened; every open report about the same item joins it.
effect.link: The report joins the open case about the same item.
effect.dismiss: The report is closed without a case. The reporter is not told the reason.

moderation.orgLocations: Correct it on the organization’s Locations tab

orgs.title: Organizations
orgs.intro: Find a provider, parts seller or fleet by name, slug or id. The list shows no contact data; an organization opens for a work item (a pending verification or a case).

hint.name: Part of the name, at least 2 characters.
hint.slug: The exact slug of the public profile.

effect.suspend: Its public profiles leave search and the map at once; its team can still sign in. Suspensions are never bulk.
effect.reactivate: The organization becomes active again and its suspended public profiles are published again.

orgs.merged: This organization was merged into another one.

notFound.title: Organization not found
notFound.text: No organization has this id, or it was deleted.

purpose.text: Contact data, locations and documents are read for a work item that is still open: a pending verification of this organization or an open case about it.
purpose.closed: That work item is closed or taken by someone else
purpose.none: This organization has no pending verification. Open cases about it: {{cases}}. Open one from the case queue.
purpose.readFor: Read for this work item: {{kind}}. Each read is logged.

missing.title: Not available yet
missing.text: These parts of the organization page need reads the admin plane does not offer yet; open the public profile meanwhile.

profile.name: Name
profile.noEdit: Profile fields cannot be corrected from the console yet; locations can (Locations tab).

locations.threshold: A pin counts as far from its address above {{m}} m (the region's threshold).
locations.noDistance: The address could not be located.

map.label: Map of {{name}}
map.failed: The map cannot be shown in this browser. The coordinates and the form still work.
map.noBasemap: The console shows no streets: the map has the pins and the radius only. Open the pin in a map app below to see the area.

correct.hint: Click the map or drag the proposed pin, or type the coordinates. Change only what is wrong; the rest stays as it is.
correct.effect: The point is marked as corrected by CarPal, the check runs again and the organization is told.

orgs.verificationRule: An organization is verified when its business identity and a location are verified. The Verified Business badge then waits for staff approval.

plan.noHistory: The plan history is not available yet.

assist.effect: The session lasts 4 hours and every step is recorded. Consents and terms stay with the owner. The assisted wizard opens in the business web app once it exists.
assist.started: The assist session is open until {{until}}.
assist.bannerNote: Everything done in this session is recorded as assisted onboarding. Keep this page open: after a reload the console cannot show the session any more (it still ends by itself).

verification.title: Verification
verification.intro: Business and location checks waiting for a decision. CarPal promises an answer within 2 working days.
verification.pick: Pick a request from the queue.
verification.orgUnavailable: The organization cannot be read for this request any more (decided, or taken by someone else).
verification.notInContract: Registration number, owner and call-back result are not part of the request yet.

docs.title: Documents
docs.none: No documents were submitted with this check.
docs.closed: The documents are read only while the request is pending.

check.address_matches_pin: The address exists and matches the map pin
check.taxonomy_consistent: Claimed services make sense for the business type

far.title: A pin is far from its address
far.text: Correct the pin or the address before approving a location check.
far.link: Correct it on the Locations tab

block.far_apart: A pin is far from its address: correct it first.
block.checklist: Tick every checklist item to approve.

verification.noMoreInfo: Asking the business for more information is not available yet: reject with what to fix, or contact them.
verification.messageHint: What to fix, in words the business understands (up to 500 characters).

messageProblem.required: Write what the business should fix.

dialog.checklist: Checklist: {{n}} of {{total}} ticked (saved with the reason).

verified.title: Approve this check
verified.effect: The check is verified. With business identity and a location verified, the organization becomes verified.

rejected.title: Reject this check
rejected.effect: The check is rejected and the business is told your message.

verification.orgNow: The organization's verification status is now: {{status}}.
verification.badgeNext: The Verified Business badge is awarded by the trust check and waits for staff approval (organization page, Verification tab).
verification.cannotDecide: Only moderators and platform admins decide verification requests.
verification.linkGone: This request is not waiting for a decision any more (decided, expired or not found). Pick one from the queue.

suspension.label: Suspend for
suspension.summaryOpen: The account stays suspended until someone reactivates it.
suspension.summaryUntil: The account is reactivated automatically on {{when}}.

privacy.title: Privacy requests
privacy.intro: Requests from users about their data: export, deletion, correction and consent withdrawal. Each one has a legal due date; most urgent first.
privacy.pick: Pick a request from the queue.
privacy.notListed: This request is not on the current page of the queue. Change the filters or page through the queue to find it.
privacy.cannotAct: Your role can read this queue but not work on requests.
privacy.overdue: This request is past its due date.
privacy.exportReady: Ready for the user to download
privacy.openUser: Open the user's account for this request
privacy.rejectionRequired: Write the reason the user will read.
privacy.completeNeedsFile: Mark the request completed only after the export file is built; the user then downloads it from the app.

typeNote.export: The export covers every module, including notes businesses keep about the user. Staff never download it: the user does, from the app.
typeNote.deletion: The console cannot show yet which data will be deleted and which anonymized, or what must be kept and why. Check open disputes and legal holds before you run the deletion.
typeNote.rectification: The console cannot list the records the request concerns yet. Correct the data where it lives (or ask the owning business), then complete the request with what you did in the reason.
typeNote.consent_withdrawal: Staff cannot withdraw a consent for a user. Ask the user to withdraw it in the app's privacy settings, or record what was done, then complete the request.

moved.completed: The request is completed. The user is told.
moved.rejected: The request is rejected. The user is told why.

stepHint.received: First check that the request comes from the account holder.
stepHint.verifying_identity: Continue once you are sure who made the request.
stepHint.in_progress: Do the work, then complete the request.

effect.verifying_identity: The request moves to the identity check.
effect.in_progress: You confirm the identity; the request moves to processing.
effect.completed: The request is closed as done and the user is told.
effect.rejected: The request is closed and the user reads the reason below.

export.title: Export file
export.text: The export is built in the background. When it is ready, the user downloads it from the app (the link expires after 7 days).
export.effect: A new export file is built from the user's current data.

deletion.title: Run the deletion
deletion.text: Deletes the account's private data and anonymizes the content it published, following the retention rules. It runs only after a second administrator approves it.
deletion.noPreview: The console cannot show a preview of what is deleted yet.
deletion.adminOnly: Only a platform admin can run a deletion.
deletion.effect: After a second administrator approves, the account's private data is deleted. This cannot be undone.

job.unreadable: The progress of the export cannot be read. Reload the page later.
job.queued: The export is waiting to start.
job.succeeded: The export file is ready. You can now mark the request completed.
job.failed: The export failed. Build it again; if it fails again, tell the engineering team.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Find a user for the work item you are on: a case, dispute, privacy request or verification. You only find the people that item is about.
users.readFor: Read for this work item: {{kind}}. Each read and search is logged.
users.deleted: This account is deleted. Nothing can be changed.
users.none: Nobody found. Only the people this work item is about can be found.

search.label: Find a user

problem.invalid: This does not look right for the chosen kind.

search.logged: Every search is logged with the work item.
search.error: The search did not work. Check that the work item is still open, then try again.

unavailable.title: This user cannot be shown
unavailable.mismatch: This user is not part of the work item you opened the page from.
unavailable.other: The user cannot be read for this work item now (it may be closed). Open the user again from an open work item.

missing.title: More about this user
missing.text: Vehicles, appointments, consents, sessions and devices, privacy requests, content and cases come in a later stage (AC14).

done.suspend: The account is suspended and signed out everywhere.

effect.suspend: The user is signed out everywhere and cannot use the account until it is reactivated.
effect.reactivate: The user can sign in and use the account again.

signOut.done: The user is signed out on every device.
signOut.effect: Every session of the account ends. Use it when the account may be in the wrong hands.

onboarding.effect: The user starts this onboarding again from the first step. Saved data stays.

staff.title: Staff roles
staff.text: Platform roles give access to this console. A new role takes effect only after a second platform admin approves it; removing a role works at once.
staff.none: This user has no staff role.

effect.grant: A second platform admin must approve this in Pending approvals within 72 hours.
effect.revoke: The role ends at once and the user loses its access.

codes.title: Your recovery codes
codes.text: Each code works once, if you lose your security key. Print them or write them down and keep them somewhere safe, away from the key.
codes.once: They are shown only now. CarPal cannot show them again; you can make a new set on the Security keys page.

security.title: Security keys and recovery codes
security.intro: You sign in to the admin console with a security key that stays on one device. Keep a backup key and your recovery codes, so you can get back in if you lose a key.
security.stepUpHint: Each change asks for your security key again when you signed in more than 5 minutes ago.
security.otherSessions: Your other sessions end and you get an email.

armed.add: Confirmed with your security key. Press "Add backup key" again within 5 minutes.
armed.codes: Confirmed with your security key. Press "New recovery codes" again within 5 minutes.
armed.remove: Confirmed with your security key. Confirm the removal again within 5 minutes.

errors.lastKey: This is your only security key that can sign in. Add a backup key before you remove it.
errors.limit: You have {{n}} keys, the most an account can have. Remove one first.
errors.keyRejected: The key could not be checked. Try again.
errors.alreadyRegistered: This security key is already registered for your account. Use another key.
errors.load: Your keys could not be loaded.

keys.title: Security keys
keys.added: Backup key "{{name}}" added. Your other sessions ended.
keys.removed: Key "{{name}}" removed. Your other sessions ended.
keys.notBound: This key syncs across devices and cannot sign in to the admin console.
keys.onlyOne: You have one key that can sign in. Add a backup key, so a lost key does not lock you out.
keys.addText: A USB or NFC security key, or this computer’s built-in key. Passkeys that sync to a phone or a cloud account are not accepted.
keys.label: Name of the key
keys.labelHint: For example "Blue USB key" (up to {{n}} characters).
keys.labelLong: The name can have at most {{n}} characters.
keys.removeText: The key "{{name}}" will no longer sign in.

codes.title: Recovery codes
codes.text: Use a recovery code if you lose your security key. A new set replaces the old one: the old codes stop working.
codes.newText: Your current recovery codes stop working at once. The new codes are shown only once.
codes.made: New recovery codes were made. The old ones no longer work.

restricted.title: Your account was recovered recently
restricted.text: Until {{when}} you cannot approve changes, grant roles or re-enable staff members.

noCodes.title: You have no recovery codes left
noCodes.text: Without them you cannot recover your account if you lose your security key.

recoveries.title: Recovery requests
recoveries.intro: Staff members who lost their security key ask to recover their account. Two different administrators must approve; one rejection ends the request. Check with the person outside CarPal before you approve.
recoveries.empty: No recovery requests in this view.
recoveries.passwordForgotten: Forgotten (a new one is set at the end)
recoveries.notFound: This request could not be found.
recoveries.pick: Pick a request from the list.
recoveries.closed: This request is {{status}}; nothing more to decide.
recoveries.approvedByMe: You approved this request. A second administrator must approve too.
recoveries.checkFirst: Before you approve: call the person on a number you already know, meet them, or see them on a video call. Never approve from an email or a chat message alone.

method.phone_known_number: Call to a known phone number

approve.title: Approve the recovery
approve.effect: With the second approval the staff member can set a new key; their old keys and codes stop working.
approve.method: How did you check the person?
approve.methodRequired: Choose how you checked the person.
approve.noteHint: For example the number you called. Do not write codes or passwords.
approve.noteRequired: Describe how you checked the person.

reject.title: Reject the recovery
reject.effect: The request ends and the staff member is told by email.

recoveries.own: This is your own recovery request: other administrators decide it.

notices.recoveryWaiting: {{staff_name}} asked to recover their staff account. Check with the person outside CarPal before you approve it.
notices.recoveryDone: The staff account of {{staff_name}} was recovered with a new security key. For 72 hours it cannot approve changes or grant roles.
notices.breakGlass: The security keys and recovery codes of {{staff_name}} were reset from the server. If nobody expected this, disable the account and investigate.
notices.killSwitch: The AI automation kill switch is now {{enabled}}. While it is on, every AI feature and AI write tool is stopped.
notices.title: Notices
notices.failed: The notices could not be loaded.
notices.unknown: A notice this console does not know yet ({{key}}).

fourEyesStatus.expired: not decided in time and expired

notices.dsrDeadline: {{request_count}} privacy requests are close to their legal deadline.
notices.rateReminder: Enter today's exchange rate for {{currency}} (in force: {{per_usd}} per US dollar).

taxonomy.title: Taxonomy
taxonomy.searchHint: Any label (English or Persian) or slug
taxonomy.capped: This type has more nodes than the console reads at once; some are not shown.
taxonomy.loadFailed: This could not be loaded. Try again.
taxonomy.empty: No nodes of this type yet.
taxonomy.noMissing: Every node of this type has all its labels.
taxonomy.notInType: This node is not of the chosen type, or it is not there any more.
taxonomy.pick: Pick a node, or add one.

editor.slugPattern: Use lower-case Latin letters, digits and hyphens (e.g. pars-tondar).
editor.parentRequired: Choose a parent: this type cannot stand alone.
editor.regionsPattern: Use two-letter country codes separated by commas (e.g. IR, AE).
editor.sortRange: Use a whole number from 0 to 100000.
editor.mergedReadOnly: This node was merged into another one and can no longer be edited.
editor.readOnly: You can read this node; platform admins edit it.
editor.name: Label ({{language}})
editor.slugHint: Part of links and imports; Latin letters, digits and hyphens.
editor.regionsHint: Leave empty for every region; else country codes, e.g. IR.
editor.statusHint: Deprecated: hidden from new choices; existing references are kept.
editor.mismatch: The catalog rules refuse this: the parent is of a type this node cannot have, or it would make a circle.
editor.duplicate: Another node of this type already has this slug.

synonyms.title: Synonyms and spellings
synonyms.duplicate: This node already has this term in this language and script.
synonyms.scriptMissing: Choose the script of the transliteration.
synonyms.hint: Latin-letter Persian (e.g. "pishkhan") is a transliteration in Persian with the Latin script.

mappings.title: Mappings
mappings.weightHint: 0 to 100: how strongly the two belong together.
mappings.weightRange: Use a whole number from 0 to 100.
mappings.mismatch: The node types do not fit this mapping.

merge.title: Merge into another node
merge.text: Use this for a duplicate. The node is merged into the one you choose:
merge.effectReferences: Every reference (vehicles, capabilities, inventory, reviews, appointments) moves to the chosen node in a background job.
merge.effectStatus: This node becomes "merged" and leads to the chosen one; it cannot be undone.
merge.effectFourEyes: A second platform admin must approve the merge on Pending approvals first.
merge.noPreview: The console cannot list the references that will move before the merge (not in the contract).
merge.cycleGuard: Only live nodes of the same type that are not below this one (no circular parents).
merge.mismatch: The catalog refuses this merge: the nodes are of different types, or the target is below this node.

terms.title: Zero-result searches
terms.intro: How often a search found nothing, as a share of all searches. A rising share points at missing synonyms or nodes.
terms.noTerms: The analytics give counts only, not the words people typed, so the terms cannot be listed here. Add synonyms on a node from what support tickets and reports show.

dash.triageLater: Safety-critical triage sessions are counted once the triage review arrives (next phase).
dash.orgsNote: New organizations: published provider profiles (the analytics store counts no other organization events yet).
dash.fraudLater: Fraud flags and review velocity alerts have no data source yet.

signals.media_scan_failures: Files the virus scan could not check

dash.smsSimulated: Simulated: no text message leaves the server
dash.mailFile: Written to the server's outbox file only

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.intro: The MVP success metrics, counted per day for the whole platform. Aggregates only: no person can be picked out. Counts add up over the period; states (marked "as of") are the latest day's.
analytics.allEmpty: No data in this period yet. Numbers appear once the hourly aggregation has counted events.

problem.order: The first day must not be after the last.

chart.summary: {{name}}, daily from {{from}} to {{to}}, highest {{max}}. Use the arrow keys to read each day; the numbers are also in the table below.

activation.name: Activation
activation.about: Sign-ups, vehicles added, onboarding steps and app opens: are new people getting started?

matching.name: Matching
matching.about: Searches, searches without a result, results opened and appointment requests.

search_and_map.name: Search and map
search_and_map.about: Searches, zero results, edited interpretation chips, safety banners and how the map is used (opens, pins, vehicle filter, directions).

trust.name: Trust
trust.about: Reviews published, disputes opened, badges awarded and moderation actions.

reviews.name: Reviews
reviews.about: Reviews written and published, approval requests and approvals, invitations sent and opened.

provider_value.name: Provider value
provider_value.about: Appointment requests, confirmations and completions, and profile views for repair businesses.

vendor_value.name: Vendor value
vendor_value.about: Inquiries, profile views and published vendors.

fleet_value.name: Fleet value
fleet_value.about: Fleet approval requests and decisions, and active fleets.

growth.name: Growth
growth.about: New users and provider profiles, and how many users, providers, vendors and fleets are active.

moderation_load.name: Moderation load
moderation_load.about: Reported reviews, moderation actions and what is open: cases, reports, review approvals and privacy requests.

ai_quality.name: AI quality
ai_quality.about: AI outputs, pending suggestions, accepted and rejected feedback and hallucination reports.

metric.mapVehicleFilter: Vehicle filter toggles on the map

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Who changed what, when and why, for any record: staff, users, the system and AI clients.
audit.appendOnly: The audit log is append-only: nobody can edit or delete an entry.

search.title: Search
search.badId: Enter a full ID (36 characters) or leave it empty.
search.recorded: Each search is recorded in the audit log with your name.

problem.order: The first day must not be after the last.

audit.idle: Choose filters and press Search. Nothing is read before that.

mcp.title: MCP clients and access log
mcp.pick: Choose a client to see its access.

access.title: Access
access.intro: Tick what this client may use. Groups follow the MCP catalog (Docs/53). Only the lists you change are sent.
access.otherNote: Values this console does not know. They stay unless you untick them.

mcp.fourEyes: A second platform admin must approve this before it takes effect.
mcp.suspendNote: Suspending stops the client at once: every AI feature that uses it stops until it is reactivated.
mcp.reactivateNote: Reactivating waits for a second platform admin.
mcp.revokedNote: A revoked client cannot be used again.
mcp.notInContract: Creating clients, token rotation, rate limits and a usage graph are not available yet.

dialog.suspendEffect: The client stops at once. AI features that use it stop working.

log.title: MCP access log
log.intro: Every AI read of data and every AI tool call, with the policy decision and the consent behind it. The log cannot be changed.
log.principalHint: Exact match; the search is recorded.
log.idle: Choose filters and press Search. Nothing is read before that.
log.entry: Looking for entry {{id}}: search the day and client it belongs to; it is marked when it is in the results.

overview.title: AI quality and safety
overview.notInContract: Volume and cost per feature, edit-before-accept and override rates, latency, errors, model and prompt versions and a language split are not in the analytics data yet.

kill.title: AI automation
kill.adminsOnly: The kill switch state is visible to platform admins.

alert.acceptance: Acceptance rate {{rate}} is below the target

insights.title: AI outputs
insights.intro: Outputs the AI features produced, with their confidence, approval state and safety flags.
insights.readOnly: Read only: marking outputs right or wrong and the evaluation set arrive with the AI build (next phase).
insights.pick: Choose an output to see it.
insights.notInPage: The output is not on this page of results. Narrow the search (type, organization, day).
insights.decisionsLater: Review decisions (Mark OK, Mark wrong, prompt ticket, evaluation set) arrive with the AI build.

detail.subject: About
detail.log: MCP access log of that day

staffDir.title: Staff & permissions
staffDir.intro: Everyone with a platform role: their roles, security keys, last sign-in and whether the account may use the console.
staffDir.gaps: Invitations and staff access requests are not available yet. A new staff account is created on the server (staff bootstrap) and gets its roles here.
staffDir.empty: No staff member matches these filters.
staffDir.pick: Choose a staff member to see their roles and access.
staffDir.approvalsLink: Role grants and enables waiting for a second admin are in Pending approvals

access.title: Console access
access.self: You cannot disable your own account. Ask another platform admin.
access.disableText: Disabling works at once: every role is suspended, every session ends and the member's requests waiting in Pending approvals are rejected.
access.enableText: Enabling gives the suspended roles back after a second platform admin approves it.

effect.disable: All of this member's roles are suspended and their sessions end now. Their own four-eyes requests still waiting are rejected ("requester disabled"). The last active platform admin cannot be disabled.
effect.enable: A second platform admin must approve this in Pending approvals within 72 hours.

staffDir.notFound: No staff member has this link. They may have been removed from the staff.

policies.title: Policies & consent texts
policies.intro: The texts people agree to, with their versions. A published version cannot be changed: write a new version and publish it with a date. Publishing waits for a second platform admin.
policies.empty: No policy documents for this region.
policies.pick: Choose a document to see its versions.
policies.pickVersion: Open a version to see its audit trail.
policies.noVersions: This document has no version yet.
policies.newFrom: Starts from the texts of version {{label}}. Give it a new label.
policies.loadFailed: The version could not be loaded.
policies.readOnly: This version is read-only. To change the text, write a new version.
policies.draftNote: A draft is not shown to anyone until it is published.

field.label: Version label
field.labelHint: What people accept, for example 1.1. Unique within the document.
field.title: Title ({{locale}})
field.bodyHint: Markdown without HTML, up to 60,000 characters.
field.summaryHint: Optional. If you write it, write it in both languages.

problem.label: Enter a label of up to 20 characters.
problem.title: Enter a title of up to 200 characters.
problem.summary: Write the summary in both languages (up to 1,000 characters each), or leave both empty.

key.service_history_sharing: Service history shared with a shop
key.vendor_fitment_context: Vehicle details shared with a parts seller
key.fleet_driver_data_visibility: Driver data visible to a fleet

modeText.blocking: When a new version asks for re-consent, people must accept it before they go on using the app.
modeText.notice: When a new version asks for re-consent, people see a notice once.
modeText.consent: A consent text. When a new version asks for re-consent, people confirm or withdraw their consents under it.

publish.title: Publish
publish.when_approval: As soon as a second admin approves
publish.approvalHint: The version comes into force when it is approved.
publish.problem_when: Enter a day and a time.
publish.problem_past: Choose a time that is not in the past.
publish.reconsent: People must agree to this version again

reconsentEffect.blocking: If ticked, people must accept the new version before they go on.
reconsentEffect.notice: If ticked, people see a notice about the new version once.
reconsentEffect.consent: If ticked, people with a consent under an older text are asked to confirm it.

actionHint.keep: They stay in effect until the person confirms or withdraws them.
actionHint.pause: They count as not given until the person confirms them.

publish.summaryApproval: In force as soon as a second platform admin approves.
publish.summaryAt: In force from {{at}} (or at approval, if that is later).
publish.fourEyes: A second platform admin must approve this in Pending approvals within 72 hours.
publish.scheduledExists: Version {{label}} is already scheduled. Another version can be published once it is in force.

notif.title: Notifications & templates
notif.intro: The texts of emails, push messages and SMS, the rules for invitations and reminders, and how well messages are delivered. In-app texts are part of the apps and are not edited here.
notif.previewHint: Preview shows the text with sample values, checked as a save would check it.
notif.pick: Choose a template to see or change its text.
notif.alwaysText: A critical alert: people cannot switch it off.
notif.missingText: This language has no text of its own (none, or a copy of the other language).
notif.outdatedText: The other language was edited by staff and this one was not. Check that both say the same.
notif.lockedTransactional: Locked: links, codes, invitations and account security messages keep their built-in text.
notif.lockedAlways: Locked: critical alerts keep their built-in text.

field.subject: Subject
field.bodyHint: Up to 4,000 characters. Use only the placeholders listed above, written as {name}.

problem.subject: Enter a one-line subject of up to 200 characters.
problem.unknown: These placeholders are not available here: {{names}}.

dialog.reset: Use the built-in text of {{key}} again

rules.delayHint: After the appointment is completed; 0 sends at once; at most 2,880 (2 days).
rules.invitationDays: Reminders to the customer (days after the invitation)
rules.daysHint: Up to three days from 1 to 6, ascending, for example 2, 5. Empty: no reminders. The link expires after 7 days.
rules.approvalDays: Reminders to the business about approval requests (days)
rules.approvalDaysHint: Up to three days from 1 to 6, ascending, for example 3, 6. The business has 7 days to answer.
rules.quietHint: For people who have not set their own; on their clock. Critical alerts are always delivered.
rules.alwaysNote: Critical alerts (security, safety) are always delivered and cannot be switched off.
rules.saved: Rules saved. They apply from the next run of each sweep.
rules.effect: Reminders already sent are not repeated, and a maintenance reminder already due stays due.

problem.days: Enter up to three days from 1 to 6, ascending, separated by commas.
problem.quietEnd: Enter a time as HH:MM that differs from the start.

rules.odometerDays: Ask owners for a mileage reading after (days)
rules.odometerHint: Days without a reading before the owner is asked for one: 14 to 90, or 0 to turn the prompt off. Fleet vehicles are not asked.

health.intro: Deliveries by channel and provider; counts only, no recipients or texts. Updated {{at}}.
health.empty: No deliveries in the last 30 days.

support.title: Support inbox
support.intro: Questions and problems people send from the apps. Answer within one working day; the clock stops while a ticket waits on the person.
support.pick: Choose a ticket to read it.
support.contactHint: (contact details on the user page, for this ticket)

assign.title: Assign
assign.solved: A solved ticket is not assigned.

reply.title: Reply
reply.solved: A reply reopens the ticket for the person.
reply.bodyHint: Up to 4,000 characters. The person sees it from "CarPal", never your name.
reply.keepWithTeam: Keep the ticket with the team (for example after an acknowledgement)
reply.sent: Reply sent. The person is notified.
reply.effectUser: The ticket then waits on the person and the team's clock stops.
reply.effectTeam: The ticket stays with the team and its clock keeps running.

convert.title: Turn into
convert.idHint: The ID of the record (a UUID).
convert.floor: This reason is handled at least as high severity.
convert.statementHint: Carried into the item. Empty: the first message of the ticket.
convert.done: Work item created. It follows its own queue.
convert.effect: The item is created with the person's words; the person is not notified (answer in the conversation).

problem.target: Choose what it is about and enter its ID.
problem.disputeTarget: Choose what the dispute is about and enter its ID.
problem.organization: A plan request needs a ticket filed for a business.

close.title: Close
close.needsItem: "Turned into a work item" needs a linked item first.
close.done: Ticket solved. The person is notified.
close.effect: Outcome: {{outcome}}. The person can reopen it by replying within 14 days.

support.solvedNote: A solved ticket is closed to staff. If the person replies within 14 days, it opens again in the inbox.
support.notOpen: This ticket cannot be opened for you: it is solved, or a colleague is handling it. Check the list for its state.
